name: DWH MetaModule Catalog Projection
purpose: provide one deterministic browse/coverage projection for Universal families, Composition groupings, actual MetaModules, and unresolved membership/identity gaps without promoting projections into semantic authority
sourceAuthority: canonical DWH/AIGMos semantic definitions and explicit registry evidence
rules: BusinessSuite, Strategy and Everyday are grouping abstractions in the current grouping model and are NOT_EVENT_OWNER
actual member Composition MetaModules own their own semantics and Event review
display labels never become canonical IDs by projection
historical DOMAIN::*/SUITE::* identifiers must not be revived as current identities without explicit evidence
no new BUSINESS::, STRATEGY:: or EVERYDAY:: namespace may be invented
catalog projection is rebuildable and does not become a second canonical registry
mmdemo.* synthetic records may reference catalog entries but may not become canonical evidence
